mapper.select: select a.device_id, a.device_name, n.device_mete_id, f.cruise_type, f.result_num, g.dict_note as cruise_type_name, n.instance_id, j.task_id, h.warn_id, h.warn_level as alarm_level, k.dict_note as alarm_level_name, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName from t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance n on a.device_id = n.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON n.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON n.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON n.cruise_id = d.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on n.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_type and g.col_name = 'cruise_type' LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result j on j.task_result_id = e.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_warn_info h on h.task_id = j.task_id and h.instance_id = n.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k on k.dict_code = h.warn_level and k.col_name = 'alarm_level' where a.device_id = (SELECT id from three_dimensional_relevancy where model_name = #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) GROUP BY instance_id
SELECT id,is_camera from three_dimensional_relevancy where 1 = 1 and model_name = #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.device_id, a.device_name, b.device_mete_id, d.instance_id, d.cruise_id, e.camera_id, e.preset_name, f.camera_name, f.record_id FROM t_std_device a, t_std_devicemete b, t_cruise_point_instance d, t_camera_preset e, t_camera_info f WHERE 1 = 1 and a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id and b.device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType = BIGINT} and b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id and d.cruise_id = e.preset_id and e.camera_id = f.camera_id GROUP BY e.preset_id

SELECT b.preset_id as cruise_id, a.camera_id, a.record_id, a.camera_name, b.preset_name FROM t_camera_info a, t_camera_preset b WHERE a.camera_id = b.camera_id and a.camera_id = #{cameraId,jdbcType = BIGINT}

SELECT IFNULL(d.count, 0) AS count, b.dict_code, b.dict_note FROM t_dict_business b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.alarm_level, count(a.alarm_level) AS count FROM ( SELECT warn_level AS alarm_level, warn_id FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL ( SELECT defect_level, defect_id FROM t_defect_info ) ) a GROUP BY a.alarm_level ) d ON d.alarm_level = b.dict_code WHERE b.col_name = 'alarm_level'
SELECT a.model_name as modelName, a.`name` as titleName FROM three_dimensional_relevancy a

select a.plan_id, a.plan_code, a.device_id, a.up_region_id, a.robot_id, a.plan_name, a.type, b.dict_note AS type_name, a.plan_point_types, (select count(*) from t_cruise_plan_attr b where b.plan_id = a.plan_id) as total, a.create_time, a.update_time from t_cruise_plan a JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.type = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = "plan_type" where 1 = 1 and a.plan_code = #{planCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.up_region_id = #{upRegionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.plan_name like concat('%',#{planName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.type = #{type, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.plan_point_types = #{planPointTypes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.plan_id in (SELECT DISTINCT d.plan_id FROM t_cruise_plan_attr d LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance e ON d.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection f ON f.inspection_id = e.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset g ON e.cruise_id = g.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete h ON h.device_mete_id = e.device_mete_id WHERE e.device_id IS NOT NULL and e.device_id = ( SELECT id FROM three_dimensional_relevancy WHERE model_name = #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
order by a.create_time desc
